name: Dame Tu Sangre
source:
After losing everything you once had, step into the role of the protagonist and embark on an adventure discovering the supernatural world, surrounded by handsome and dangerous boys. Will you dare to make a blood pact without falling in love?

[From [url=https://dolcewitchgames.itch.io/dame-tu-sangre]Itch.io[/url]]
